Name: Reward Bursts
Author: Cseron
Description:
[size=6][b]Reward Bursts 1.17.0[/b][/size]

[b]Current version: 1.17.0[/b] — for Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2 or later.

Reward Bursts turns routine Stardew Valley activities into visible, player-controlled reward challenges.

Instead of permanently multiplying every drop, the mod asks you to build progress toward a burst. You can prepare the counter with ordinary targets, choose a valuable final action, and trigger a satisfying explosion of bonus loot.

Farming, ground foraging, forestry, mining, fishing, and combat each have an independent three-stage daily chain:

[list]
[*][b]Normal burst[/b] — ×1 bonus.[/*]
[*][b]Enhanced burst[/b] — ×1.5 bonus by default.[/*]
[*][b]Mega burst[/b] — ×2 bonus by default.[/*]
[/list]
Every payout resets that module's current counter and advances its chain. After the mega burst, that module closes until the next morning. The enhanced and mega multipliers are configurable.

Press [b]Left Shift + B[/b] to open the scrollable progress dashboard. It shows every counter, current chain stage, effective reward, eligibility rules, and whether optional bonus experience is enabled.

[size=5][b]Farming — Focused Harvest[/b][/size]

Each supported crop has its own daily counter. One cycle requires 40 manual harvests of the same crop; harvesting another crop advances only its own counter.

[list]
[*]Farming 1–4: harvest 40 plants of one crop, base reward +10 copies.[/*]
[*]Farming 5–9: harvest 40 plants of one crop, base reward +15 copies.[/*]
[*]Farming 10: harvest 40 plants of one crop, base reward +20 copies.[/*]
[/list]
With the default chain multipliers, the three rewards are +10 / +15 / +20, +15 / +23 / +30, or +20 / +30 / +40 respectively.

A Farming payout resets every crop counter. Every successful harvest of a regrowing crop counts again while the plant remains in the ground. Multi-yield plants such as blueberries, cranberries, and coffee count as one harvest per bush. Junimos, fruit trees, tea bushes, giant crops, and wild-seed crops are excluded. Scythe harvesting is configurable and disabled by default.

[size=5][b]Foraging — Shared Collection Cycle[/b][/size]

All eligible forage items fill one deterministic counter and may be mixed freely. The find which completes the cycle determines the bonus item, quality, and optional experience.

[list]
[*]Foraging 1–4: collect 3 eligible finds, base reward +3 copies.[/*]
[*]Foraging 5–9: collect 4 finds, base reward +4 copies.[/*]
[*]Foraging 10: collect 5 finds, base reward +5 copies.[/*]
[/list]
With the default chain multipliers, the three rewards are +3 / +5 / +6, +4 / +6 / +8, or +5 / +8 / +10 respectively. Preparing the counter with cheap finds and finishing it with a valuable find is intentional.

Natural ground forage, beach forage, spring onions, and optional berry bushes are supported. Truffles, player-dropped items, cave products, wild crops, garbage cans, and chest contents are excluded.

[size=5][b]Forestry — Forest Burst[/b][/size]

Adult vanilla oak, maple, pine, and mahogany trees share one counter and can be mixed freely. The tree which completes the cycle determines the bonus loot table. Vanilla large stumps use a separate counter, but share the same Forest chain.

[list]
[*]Foraging 1–4: 3 trees or large stumps, +1 independent matching loot roll.[/*]
[*]Foraging 5–9: 4 targets, +2 rolls.[/*]
[*]Foraging 10: 5 targets, +3 rolls.[/*]
[/list]
Only final destruction by the local player's axe counts. Ordinary tree stumps, large fallen logs, explosions, palms, mushroom trees, mystic trees, Green Rain trees, and unknown modded trees are excluded.

[size=5][b]Mining — Ore Hunt[/b][/size]

Copper, iron, gold, iridium, and radioactive ore nodes each have a separate counter. The first ore type to complete a cycle triggers the current Mining-chain reward and resets every ore counter.

[list]
[*]Mining 1–4: destroy 4 matching ore nodes, base reward +4 ore.[/*]
[*]Mining 5–9: destroy 6 matching nodes, base reward +6 ore.[/*]
[*]Mining 10: destroy 8 matching nodes, base reward +8 ore.[/*]
[/list]
Pickaxes, Cherry Bombs, Bombs, Mega Bombs, explosive ammunition, and other player-attributed explosions are supported. Ordinary stones, coal, geode, gem and mystic nodes, and unknown modded ore nodes are excluded.

[size=5][b]Fishing — Focused Catch[/b][/size]

By default, every ordinary rod minigame which successfully yields a fish advances one shared Fishing counter. The threshold fish remains as the normal catch and creates bonus copies with the same final quality.

[list]
[*]Fishing 1–4: 4 catches, base reward +2 fish.[/*]
[*]Fishing 5–9: 6 catches, base reward +3 fish.[/*]
[*]Fishing 10: 8 catches, base reward +4 fish.[/*]
[/list]
Players who want a harder version can enable [b]Require Perfect Catch[/b]. In that mode, imperfect catches neither advance nor reset progress. Wild Bait and Challenge Bait still advance the counter only once per minigame. Legendary fish are intentionally eligible.

Crab pots, fish ponds, algae, trash, treasure-chest contents, festival minigames, and catches without the ordinary fishing minigame are excluded.

[size=5][b]Combat — Trophy Hunt[/b][/size]

Every explicitly supported vanilla monster type has a separate daily counter. Dangerous variants remain separate targets. All supported slime varieties intentionally share one slime-family counter.

[list]
[*]Combat 1–4: 5 kills of one type, 6 additional ordinary loot-table rolls.[/*]
[*]Combat 5–9: 10 kills, 10 rolls.[/*]
[*]Combat 10: 15 kills, 20 rolls.[/*]
[/list]
With the default chain multipliers, the effective rewards are 6 / 9 / 12 rolls at Combat 1–4, 10 / 15 / 20 at Combat 5–9, and 20 / 30 / 40 at Combat 10.

Bonus rolls do not copy the threshold monster's actual drop. Instead, that monster's ordinary vanilla loot table is rolled independently. Every effective roll also grants one matching kill toward Adventurer's Guild eradication goals, active journal slay quests, and active special orders. Burglar's Ring doubles loot checks but not goal credit or optional XP. Synthetic kills do not charge Reward Bursts, repeat the full death handler, or reproduce guaranteed, story, quest, and one-time drops.

[size=5][b]Archaeology — Artifact Resonance[/b][/size]

Dig up 10 vanilla artifact spots to receive 5 independent bonus artifact-spot rolls.

Unlike the six skill chains, Archaeological Resonance persists overnight. After a payout it returns to zero, and only one archaeological payout is available per day by default. Treasure Totem artifact spots count normally. Seed Spots, ordinary soil, fixed caches, Golden Walnuts, quest rewards, and unknown modded spots are excluded.

Archaeology never grants bonus skill experience.

[size=5][b]Optional Bonus Experience[/b][/size]

Bonus experience is [b]disabled by default[/b]. When enabled, successful Farming, Foraging, Forestry, Mining, Fishing, and Combat bursts grant the vanilla skill experience represented by the chain-adjusted bonus loot. Combat grants the threshold monster's vanilla XP multiplied by the effective roll count in one total; farm monsters retain vanilla's one-third XP rule. Burglar's Ring and synthetic Guild/quest kill credit do not multiply XP. Experience passes through the normal game method, so ordinary level-ups, mastery, and compatible external experience modifiers still apply.

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

Every module can be enabled or disabled separately. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional, but recommended. Settings include:

[list]
[*]thresholds and base rewards;[/*]
[*]enhanced and mega multipliers;[/*]
[*]optional bonus experience;[/*]
[*]perfect-only fishing;[/*]
[*]quality copying;[/*]
[*]berry bushes and scythe harvesting;[/*]
[*]HUD position and display duration;[/*]
[*]dashboard hotkey;[/*]
[*]the additional Reward Bursts sound.[/*]
[/list]
Every setting includes an English and Russian explanation inside GMCM.

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later.[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.5.2 or later[/url].[/*]
[*]Download Reward Bursts and extract the [font=Courier New]RewardBursts[/font] folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Optional:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. Reward Bursts does not require SpaceCore or Content Patcher.

[size=5][b]What's New in 1.17.0 / Updating from 1.8.3[/b][/size]

Replace the old RewardBursts folder with the new one. Existing settings and saved progress are migrated automatically. Do not install both versions at the same time.

Version 1.17.0 doubles the standard trophy-hunt rewards to 6 / 10 / 20 base rolls. Every effective combat roll now also counts as one matching kill for Adventurer's Guild goals, journal slay quests, and special orders. Optional Combat XP follows the same effective roll count without being multiplied by Burglar's Ring, and farm-monster XP now matches vanilla's one-third rule.

Version 1.16.1 fixed repeated harvests of regrowing crops: green beans, strawberries, hops, Ancient Fruit, and other regrowing crops advance Farming progress every time they are successfully harvested. The plant remains in the ground normally, and multi-yield crops still count as one plant per harvested bush.

Version 1.16 keeps Farming focused by crop: 40 harvests of one crop per cycle, with base rewards +10 / +15 / +20 by permanent Farming tier. Ground Foraging uses the shared deterministic 3 / 4 / 5-find cycle with matching +3 / +4 / +5 base rewards. The old rising-chance mechanic has been removed.

Compared with 1.8.3, the mod also adds the Forest module, independent three-stage reward chains, ordinary fishing by default, optional perfect-only fishing, optional burst experience, the expanded progress dashboard, improved configuration, and unified thematic burst effects.

[size=5][b]Compatibility and Limitations[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Designed and tested for single-player.[/*]
[*]Uses permanent skill levels captured each morning; food buffs do not change reward tiers during the day.[/*]
[*]English and Russian localization included.[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.[/*]
[*]Unknown modded ore nodes, monsters, trees, and artifact spots are intentionally excluded unless explicitly stated otherwise.[/*]
[*]Mods which completely replace the same vanilla harvesting, fishing, mining, combat, tree-felling, or digging methods may require compatibility patches.[/*]
[*]Uninstalling Reward Bursts does not damage the save. The mod only stores its own progress values in Farmer.modData.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size]
